name: The Old Keep (Lin Lich Tower)
title: Old Keep
summary: The 'Lin Lich Tower': a tower lit with green flames on the side of a mountain north-west of Lin, reached by portal and guarded by obsidian golems, with runed chests at the top (acpedia). In the kit, a five-storey spire tower (top z 370.8) stands on a narrow ledge at z 340. Four green flame props ring its upper floor (z 354-361), chained skeletons and blood lie at its door, and the Lee Side of the Mountain portal stands beside it. The mountain wall rises west to the 520 m summit, and the slope drops 80 m east toward Lin.
